character: Mitali is an illustrative character, not a real person. Change the name in every line and in src/scenes (People.tsx, Themes.tsx) together.

cues.text: Today, in a village in Odisha, a girl named Mitali was born. One of four point seven crore.
She is a number. But numbers tell stories.
If Odisha were a hundred people, Mitali is one of eighty-three in villages. Her family will be smaller, and her life longer.
More school than her mother had.
In the city, the world opens up.
Her own job, her own money.
And one day, she grows old here.
Where she lives shapes her future. Each district has its own path.
Health data shows what is improving for her, and what still needs care.
What she searches online may show change before any survey does.
Anyone can ask about her district, and get a sourced answer.
All of it, open to everyone.
Understand the numbers, and we can plan the Odisha she deserves.
Soochana. Find your story in the numbers.
Her story's just beginning. More, coming soon.
